playstyle.identity: Kled is an aggressive bruiser who can dismount and remount his lizard Skaarl. He excels at diving and chasing with his long-range charge ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Mounted: 2 health bars (Skaarl's then Kled's). Q throws a bear trap that pulls after sticking. W gives attack speed burst. E dashes through enemies (can recast to dash back). R charges in a direction, all allies behind gain speed. Dismounted: rebuild courage to remount.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kled spikes at level 6 with his engage ultimate. Eclipse and bruiser items scale him. He's strong at all-ins and dives.

passive.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
passive.summary: Mounted on Skaarl with bonus health; dismount when Skaarl flees, remount by gaining courage.
passive.details: Kled rides Skaarl, who has his own health bar. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts with reduced abilities. Attacking champions or killing units builds courage to remount Skaarl.

abilities.name: Bear Trap on a Rope / Pocket Pistol
abilities.summary: Mounted: throw a bear trap that pulls. Dismounted: fire a pistol.
abilities.details: Mounted: Throw a bear trap that damages and pulls the first enemy hit after a duration. Dismounted: Fire your pistol, dealing damage and knocking yourself back.

abilities.name: Violent Tendencies
abilities.summary: Passive: periodically gain attack speed; 4th hit deals max health damage.
abilities.details: When activated (or passively), Kled gains massive attack speed for 4 attacks. The 4th attack deals bonus damage based on max health.

abilities.name: Jousting
abilities.summary: Dash through enemies; can recast to dash back through the same target.
abilities.details: Kled dashes, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. He can recast to dash back through the same target again.

abilities.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
abilities.summary: Charge in a direction; allies behind gain speed and you gain a shield on impact.
abilities.details: Kled charges toward a location, gaining movement speed and a shield. Allied champions behind him also gain movement speed. On arrival, he deals damage and pulls the closest enemy.
